name.ja: 1/1000 地球連邦主力戦艦ドレッドノート級 ドレッドノート
name.en: 1/1000 Earth Federation main battleship Dreadnought class Dreadnought

description.ja: • 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202』の地球艦隊の主力を成す地球連邦主力戦艦ドレッドノートがLEDユニットで輝く仕様で登場!
description.en: • The Earth Federation main battleship Dreadnought, which forms the main force of the Earth fleet in "Space Battleship Yamato 2202", is now available with a glowing LED unit!

description.ja: • 精密なディテールを再現。
• 同梱LEDユニット（青）で波動砲発射を再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the wave motion gun firing with the included LED unit (blue).

description.ja: • 同梱LEDユニット（緑）で艦橋発光を再現可能。
description.en: • Can reproduce the bridge light emission with the included LED unit (green).

description.ja: • 新規造形のコスモタイガーIIが4機付属。
description.en: • Four newly designed Cosmo Tiger IIs are included.

description.ja: • 別売LED発光ユニット（白）でエンジンとサブエンジンの発光を再現可能。
description.en: • It is possible to reproduce the light emission of the engine and sub-engine with the separately sold LED light emitting unit (white).

accessories.ja: 専用ディスプレイベース×1
艦載機 コスモタイガーII（三座）×4
accessories.en: Carrier-based aircraft Cosmo Tiger II (three seats) x 4
